description: This file defines a Null implementation of the HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache class, providing cache methods that do nothing and always return false, used when caching is disabled.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Null
classes.description: A null cache class for HTMLPurifier that disables caching by always returning false for cache operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Attempt to add a definition to the cache, but in this null implementation it does nothing and returns false.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Attempt to set a definition in the cache, but in this null implementation it does nothing and returns false.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Attempt to replace a definition in the cache, but in this null implementation it does nothing and returns false.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Attempt to remove cache entries based on config, but always returns false in this null implementation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve cached data based on config, but always returns false in this null implementation.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flush the cache, but does nothing and returns false.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Clean up cache resources, but in this implementation it does nothing and returns false.
